# Hyro Vision (https://hyrovision.com)
> High-performance digital products, AI-powered systems, and intelligent automation solutions.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: Hyro Vision
- **Website**: https://hyrovision.com
- **Description**: Hyro Vision is a modern technology and IT services engineering company. We build intelligent digital products, full-stack web applications, SaaS platforms, enterprise systems, and AI-powered automation solutions.
- **Headquarters**: Remote Worldwide · Engineering Hub
- **Founder**: Bharath (Founder of Hyrovision & Lead Systems Architect)
- **Contact Email**: info@hyrovision.com
- **Telephone**: +919360294463
- **Official Profiles**:
  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/hyrovision/

## Core Engineering Services
- **Full-Stack Web Application Development**: End-to-end web engineering, React/Next.js frontends, scalable Node.js/Python backends, and performant API architectures. (https://hyrovision.com/services/fullstack-web)
- **Custom SaaS & Enterprise Dashboards**: Multi-tenant architectures, role-based access control (RBAC), and custom enterprise management software. (https://hyrovision.com/services/saas-enterprise)
- **AI Integration & Autonomous Workflows**: Production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector embeddings, multi-provider LLM routers, and autonomous workflow automation. (https://hyrovision.com/services/ai-integration)
- **Backend Architecture & Database Design**: Resilient database modeling (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase), connection pooling, caching layers, and high-throughput APIs. (https://hyrovision.com/services/backend-database)
- **Cloud Deployment & Technical SEO**: High-availability CDN deployment on Vercel/AWS, automated CI/CD pipelines, Core Web Vitals optimization, and structured data architecture. (https://hyrovision.com/services/cloud-seo)

## Public Projects & Case Studies
- **HillsTourism** (Status: LIVE)
  - **Category**: Tourism / Travel Technology
  - **URL**: https://hillstourism.com
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/hillstourism
  - **Overview**: Full-featured tourism and travel platform featuring holiday package booking, hotel and resort reservations, transport booking flows, and administrative management.
- **Super D — Hospital Management System** (Status: ONGOING)
  - **Category**: Healthcare / Hospital Management
  - **Status Notice**: Project currently under development.
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/super-d-hospital-management-system
  - **Overview**: Comprehensive hospital information and management system engineered for electronic medical records (EMR), doctor scheduling, department workflows, and clinical operations.
- **Happy Star Satellite Vision** (Status: LIVE)
  - **Category**: Commercial / Business Management Platform
  - **URL**: https://happystarsatellitevision.netlify.app/
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/happy-star
  - **Overview**: Commercial operations and customer billing portal with automated Razorpay payment workflows and Supabase PostgreSQL data infrastructure.
- **Pakka Tourism** (Status: LIVE)
  - **Category**: Tourism Platform
  - **URL**: https://pakkatourism.com
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/pakka-tourism
  - **Overview**: Regional tourism platform providing curated holiday experiences, package reservations, and real-time Firestore travel inquiry pipelines.
- **Advanced CRM / HRMS** (Status: Completed)
  - **Category**: Enterprise Platform
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/advanced-crm-hrms
  - **Overview**: Enterprise CRM and human resource management platform unifying sales lead funnels, employee attendance, and automated payroll calculations.
- **BSmartGlass / AuraVision 2.0** (Status: Completed / Prototype Live)
  - **Category**: AI + IoT
  - **URL**: https://b-smart-glass-aura-vision.vercel.app/
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/bsmartglass-auravision
  - **Overview**: AI-powered IoT smart glasses system pairing Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W wearable hardware with WebRTC streaming and OpenAI vision analysis.
- **AI-Powered Learning Path Generator** (Status: Completed)
  - **Category**: AI Agent / Autonomous Workflow
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/ai-learning-path
  - **Overview**: Autonomous AI agent graph built with LangGraph and MCP synthesizing tailored 12-week educational curricula across YouTube, Notion, and Google Drive.
- **Alumni Connect Platform** (Status: Completed / Live)
  - **Category**: Full-Stack Networking Platform
  - **URL**: https://alumni-connection-frontend.vercel.app/
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/alumni-connect
  - **Overview**: Higher-education alumni community platform facilitating graduate mentoring, job board applications, and institutional event coordination.
- **Jojo Resort** (Status: Completed)
  - **Category**: Commercial Web Application
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/jojo-resort
  - **Overview**: High-converting luxury boutique resort booking website engineered with responsive Next.js architectures and zero layout shift.
- **Personal 3D AI Portfolio** (Status: Completed)
  - **Category**: AI + Interactive Web Experience
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/3d-ai-portfolio
  - **Overview**: Interactive 3D WebGL experience featuring custom canvas shaders, GSAP physics animations, and embedded dual-provider LLM conversational assistance.
